```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The far right poses a threat to DSA and its allies on the left in two ways.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"White supremacist shootings, such as the one in Minneapolis, demonstrate a threat to the lives of progressive organizers, protesters, and their communities.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"When planning protests and organizing campaigns, the possibility of a violent reactionary response from the police or right-wing terrorists must be taken seriously.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Far right extremism and democratic socialism both recognize that society is in crisis and propose a radical departure from the status quo.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Unlike the Left, right-wing extremists blame people of color for society's problems rather than the ruling class.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Far right politics directly competes with democratic socialism to win over downwardly-mobile and economically squeezed white people who are currently being politicized.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Nativist, racist, and misogynist terrorism and the tragedies it creates can only be ended by a mass coalition of progressive social movements fighting together.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Such a coalition must put an end to the frontal assault on Muslims, immigrants, people of color, and women.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Such a coalition must advance a coherent political analysis and program that directs white working-class anger at the billionaire class and their politics of austerity and violent repression.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
